rules.statement: A mortgage of an undivided share during the pendency of a partition action is invalid under section 17 of the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Nor is the contention tenable that section 17 does not apply, because as a matter of fact the mortgagors purported to mortgage the entire land. The plaintiff himself admits that in reality the mortgage was only of an undivided half of the land."
